description: How long a saved Suunto route will take THIS user, from their own pace on hills: reads the route's GPX (one request) and the local archive (archive_workouts; no Suunto request) and fits time = flat pace x distance + time per metre climbed + per metre descended (Naismith's rule, fitted to the newest 25 usable of the 40 newest archived walking/hiking workouts, or running ones with activity 'running'). import_workouts workouts count too (walking, hiking, running): model.workoutsUsed includes them while workoutsConsidered and skipped count the Suunto archive only. Needs 3+ usable workouts of 1 km+ with 15 km of track, 300 m climbing and 300 m descent together; otherwise model.status is 'insufficient' and the estimate is the generic Naismith rule (5 km/h plus 1 h per 600 m climbed), basis 'generic-naismith': tell the user it is NOT their pace (demo mode always falls back). A route without altitude is estimated as flat, with a note. inSampleErrorPct is fit to the past, not a forecast. `sunset` is an ISO 8601 date-time WITH UTC offset supplied by the USER (nothing is looked up); latestStart = sunset - marginMinutes - the estimate. An ESTIMATE of moving time: no stops, weather, load or fatigue.

activity.description: Which archived workouts set the pace: 'walking' (walking or hiking, default) or 'running'.

marginMinutes.description: With sunset: minutes to be back before it (default 30, 0-360).

routeId.description: Route ID from list_routes or upload_route.

sunset.description: Optional: sunset (or any finish-by time), ISO 8601 with UTC offset, supplied by the user. Adds latestStart.

name: estimate_route_time
title: Estimate a route's time from your own pace (and the latest start before sunset)
